[Spoiler= Illûche region]
[i]Northwest of Chimor and western coast of Wichansao, the region of "Illûche" was once home of the Illûche kingdom, mentioned in several khipus, but
litle was actually registered about it government, or many information .
"at the western coast of the Wichansao, there were home of the Illûche people, 50 years before the forging of empire(or 950), when organized in a confederation, a simple plot made by Taychár, on the same time Chimbote and Piwra were founded (970-975)"
The first Illûche were a confederation of tribes, but, soon due a simple plot they fallen, lasting around 70 or 75 years, the region then was reunited 2 decades later.
"However, the Illûche region soon reemerged, under a man, whose name was Urûkù Atá, the Illûche then expanded to the coast of the Wichansao western strait, and became allies with the Sangál, and  we're both responsible for trading woods and storytelling of what was after the Wichansao to Chimuan peoples.
At the year 3730(~1230), when the Sangáls were conquered by the growing Pìtipî, Illûche would remain neutral and pay Iâlcon(tribe) men and women to Pìtipî and Chimor to remain independent, their lack of people compared to both empires would make them a easy conquest, but, their were relentless on defending their land,  mounting over trees and using blowguns plus poisonous frogs poison, alongside their surprisingly silent movements on the jungles trees allowed them , under lead of king Táwíde, destroyed expeditions of both Pìtipî and Chimor, even against the Bhapac Guàmbâcho lost, and miraculously escaped with life, 2 years later Guàmbâcho would , however lost himself in the mountains at south.
At 4033, when colonialism arrived and captured  the Sapa of Pìtipî, making the empire fall, soon, conquistadores focused on Illûche kingdom, however, the Bhapac Bïssdr( /ˈbɪs.dɾ̞/) surprised even Chimús, who converted to Christianity, as the only Bhapac in region to convert, the documents  of the Illûche would be spared of being brutally burnt by the Colonizers, as Bïssdr himself would burn the pagan documents and statues, artifacts were sold and most of Illûche history now relies on Chimú fonts.
the Illûche then fought several conflicts against the Chimor, and now client state of the Colonizers, eventually Illûches would join the colonial Vespurias, as a autonomous land.
1815: the time of independences were happening and colonies were proclaiming independence, but, Illûches would not wish such, and then were expelled from colonial domains, as their colonizers not willing to keep more colonies in Vespurias, without protection, the Illûches would fall to the New Rotterdam on 1867.
.
.
 .
Present days.
But , with the collapse of the New Rotterdam, the Illûches arch would just continue, indeed, it never ended, and they, under the rule of "Míkhil Chawô", the self proclaimed "neo sapa of Illûches", but, he was never recognized, and soon, Chimor troops, led by kicbán Wamcim-Cimtum, soon suppressed the self proclaimed emperor, as Chumun-Caur stated "there can be only one [b]Sapa[/b](emperor) in the Chámôsao, and that Sapa is me".
[/I]

[i]A heavely christianized region , compared to the mostly pagan empire, would surely be a challenge to be beaten and assimilated, but we overcome colonialism and disease, "Chimor will endure as it always will, our people are strong and centuries behind only reinforce this!"
Mama Cajén(Empress) stated soon after the quickly conquest of Illûche region.
Differently of other Sangas, the Illûches will be a "Special Sanga " , with autonomy higher than the average sangas, and mainly, the local representatives to lead the Sanga, with minimum interference of the Sapa on the elections unless the candidate has a...anti Chimor vision, current governor is Tìekò Iákû, which seems pro Sapa, despite his short governance until now, his loyalty this far is...admirable.
In order to keep "Quingnam" several cities had their names altered to Chimú sounding, Casterín became "Cácheri",  other cities such as Batán, Kañûpi, Mochùmí, St Martin? Became St Mátíñi, Gresford? Géschópe, in general, this process of "quingnamization" is being used to keep and spread our language keeping our authority over conquered regions , such as Illûches.
[/i]

[/spoiler]
Notes: Contrary to Quingnam/Chimuan, which is a isolated  language, the Illûche language , as a South Vesyranean language has much of it vocabulary from the proto Vesyranean, such as the words for Ardagan, which is Ardwhos in proto Vesyranean, which in Illûche is Artá, the number 1 is onu, 2 is Dwo, 3 is treii, 4 is fátr.
Other words include:
Moon is Luna, Man is Hòbre, which has heavy influence from colonial languages
